comment: 'copyright': notices for packages whose nuspec declares none and which ship
no licence file either. MIT requires the copyright notice to travel with the
software, so an empty row does not discharge the obligation - but neither
would inventing one from the <authors> field. Copy each notice verbatim from
the licence file in the package's own repository and name it in 'source':
'assets': shipped files no deps.json names - fonts, icons. Each entry is
'license': the licence a package offered under a choice of licences is shipped
under, one of the alternatives of its expression, with where the choice is stated:
